items.title: Delaware Chancery Approves $250M Settlement in Microsoft-Activision Shareholder Suit
items.summary: 德拉瓦衡平法院 10 月 23 日批准微軟收購 Activision 股東集體訴訟 2.5 億美元和解，駁回套利基金對聯邦證券索償排除之異議，並裁定原告律師費 6,000 萬美元另加開支。
items.note: Date Decided October 23, 2026 (Sjunde AP-Fonden v. Activision Blizzard, C.A. No. 2022-1001-KSJM). publishedAt date-only → T00:00:00+08:00. Primary court opinion via Justia.
